headline: Weathered Expanse and Nevish Line Erupt as Southern Churn Subsides
war_summary: The strategic rhythm across the battlefront shifted sharply over the past three hours as base turnover flared violently in Weathered Expanse and Nevish Line while earlier hotspots tapered off. Weathered Expanse erupted with ten base exchanges in the last two hours alone, accompanied by over 1,800 casualties as Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest, and Frostmarch traded hands amid accelerating engagements. Nevish Line similarly ignited into fluid warfare, tallying eight base transfers in two hours centered upon Blackcoat Way and Tomb Father. Marban Hollow also reawakened at the flagstaffs, posting three fresh shifts across Oster Wall and Checkpoint Bua. Conversely, the rapid base churning previously observed in Palantine Berm came to a complete standstill over the past two hours, while turnover in The Gutter slowed from a torrent to merely two transactions. Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf registered solitary base exchanges before stabilizing. Behind these shifting tactical lines, Callahan's Passage remains a ferocious meat-grinder of pure attrition, devouring nearly 2,200 casualties in two hours without yielding a single strategic fort.
